title: Smart Data Models - SAREF4INMA - Area
description: https://saref.etsi.org/saref4inma/Area . A subclass of the external s4bldg:BuildingSpace class (SAREF4BLDG), used to define the physical spaces of the building. According to IEC 62264, areas are physical, geographical or logical groupings of resources determined by the site. A site can be divided into areas, and areas contain work centers. Disjoint with s4inma:Site and s4inma:WorkCenter per the ontology's AllDisjointClasses axiom.

id.description: Property. Unique identifier of the entity

type.description: Property. NGSI-LD Entity type. It must be equal to 'Area'

dateModified.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/DateTime'. Timestamp of the last modification.

source.description: Property. A sequence of characters giving the source of the entity data.

dataProvider.description: Property. A sequence of characters identifying the provider of the harmonised data entity.

contains.description: Relationship. The work centers contained in this area. Object property reused from the imported SAREF4BLDG ontology (s4bldg:contains, not redefined in the SAREF4INMA ttl itself); included here because Figure 3/8 of ETSI TS 103 410-5 explicitly uses it to structure the factory/site/area/work-center hierarchy. Target model: 'WorkCenter'.
